basis: 0.2.0 on the branch: copies of rightkit-ffmpeg deleted, typed API added, host-supplied names; read against rightkit-ffmpeg, rightkit-spend and rightkit-tts
shapeReason: The private copies are gone: the container probe and the H.264 rule are rightkit-ffmpeg's (media.rs and host/h264.rs deleted), and one JSON-setting helper replaces four copies. A typed API (typed::MediaGen: GenerateRequest to a job to Assets) sits beside the JSON commands on the same path, so a Rust host no longer adopts it as GenRight embedded.
